tenantCreate.title: Create tenant
tenantCreate.slugHint: Immutable DNS label: 3–32 characters, lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; starts with a letter, no '--'.
tenantCreate.name: Display name
tenantCreate.ownerEmailHint: Receives the invitation at the tenant configuration step (step 16).
tenantCreate.planHint: Key of an open plan (default: standard). The plan list is on the Plans screen (P4-T03).

drivers.keycloakHint: A realm of its own for the tenant (realm = slug, client mg-portal).
drivers.externalHint: The tenant's issuer and client; the client secret is write-only and never shown again.

tenantCreate.clientSecretHint: Stored in the SecretStore before the job is created; never in the job, audit or any response.
tenantCreate.domainsHint: Optional; comma separated, at most 32 domains.
tenantCreate.reviewNote: Creating the tenant writes the registry (status provisioning) and runs the 19-step tenant.provision job; you will be taken to the job timeline.

errors.name: The name must have 1–128 characters.
errors.issuer: The issuer must be an https URL.

tenantDetail.title: Tenant detail
tenantDetail.suspendDesc: Applies the deny-all policy, refuses every write of the tenant and expires its live pre-auth keys. The instance keeps running. Follow it on the job timeline.
tenantDetail.resumeDesc: Re-applies the desired policy version and reopens writes. Pre-auth keys expired by the suspension are not restored.
tenantDetail.deleteDesc: Deprovisioning: final backup, every node and key expired (point of no return), instance, data and IdP issuer removed; the slug stays reserved.
tenantDetail.deleteTwoPerson: This is a two-person action: a second person (another Super Admin) must approve the request, and both must have authenticated within the last 15 minutes.
tenantDetail.typeSlug: Type the tenant slug to confirm
tenantDetail.skipBackup: Skip the final backup (only when it cannot be taken — the approver sees this flag; the data is kept)
tenantDetail.noPermission: Your role cannot view this section.
tenantDetail.noInstance: The tenant has no instance yet.
tenantDetail.noRelay: The tenant has no relay region yet.
tenantDetail.unmeasured: Figures without a source (no made-up numbers)

job.title: Job
job.tenantCreated: The tenant is in the registry (provisioning). The 19-step progress is below and updates itself.
job.settled: The job is in a final state — no longer updating.
job.polling: Updating automatically (every 2 seconds, 5 seconds after the first minute).
job.noSteps: The job has not recorded any step yet.

control.cancelDesc: A job that has not started is cancelled at once; a running one stops after its current step and waits for a retry or a rollback.
control.retryDesc: Resumes from the failed step (finished steps are skipped); a rolled-back tenant.provision starts a new job from step 3.
control.rollbackDesc: Runs the compensation of the finished steps in reverse order. Past the point of no return the server refuses — only a retry is left.

approvals.title: Pending approvals (2P)
approvals.intro: Two-person actions of the platform. The approver must differ from the requester, hold the action's own permission and have authenticated within the last 15 minutes.
approvals.caption: Approval requests

approval.title: Approval request
approval.requestedNotice: The request was created. A second person must approve it before the action runs.
approval.payloadIntro: Exactly the parameters that run once approved — nothing else. The hash the browser computes from the payload shown must match the server's.
approval.hashUnverifiable: The payload cannot be verified in the browser — approval is not possible
approval.hashMismatch: Hashes do NOT match — do not approve
approval.closed: The request is {{status}} — it can no longer be decided.
approval.selfRequest: You made this request: a second person must approve or reject it.
approval.notPermitted: Your role cannot decide this action.
approval.stepUpNote: Approving or rejecting requires an authentication within the last 15 minutes; otherwise you will be asked to sign in again.
approval.approveDesc: The action runs right after the approval, with exactly the payload whose hash is below.
approval.rejectDesc: The request is closed; the requester has to make a new one if needed.
approval.typeSlug: Type the slug of the tenant to delete
